name: Aubrelle
summary: Aubrelle is a pendant light of quiet radiance, its form defined by soft luminosity and refined contours. A harmony of light and shadow, it captures the grace of dawn breaking through still air—serene, sculptural, and unmistakably modern. D250*H230mm / D400*H230mm Alabaster+Steel
